snippet.title: SNK Heroines Tag Team Frenzy - MissX Bends the Rules! | PS4
snippet.description:
Learn more @ https://SNKHeroines.com
Buy Now! 

The host of the Queen of Fighters tournament in SNK Gals' Fighters back in 2000, MissX returns to the arena as a participant. Although she bears a resemblance to another renowned battler, MissX is her own brand of badass! She arrives as a DLC on November 15th, and more guest characters may join as well. Stay tuned for more information! SNK HEROINES Tag Team Frenzy is out now for PlayStation 4!
